newsitem.title: AZERBAIJAN: Islamic Bank loans Azeris $13.1 mln for roads.
newsitem.headline: Islamic Bank loans Azeris $13.1 mln for roads.

text.p: The Islamic Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) has approved a $13.1 million credit to Azerbaijan for a road-building project, the Cabinet of Ministers said on Thursday.

A spokesman said the credit would be used to help rebuild the Alyat-Kazimagomet road in the north of the former Soviet republic. The road segment is part of the Europe-Caucasus-Asia highway section of the Eurasian transport corridor.

The total cost of the Europe-Caucasus-Asia project is $36.5 million. The Kuwait Fund had earlier given $18 million, and the government of Azerbaijan will pick up the rest of the cost, the spokesman said. --Tbilisi bureau +995-32 999-370
